faq.title:
What you
need to know.
faq.lede: About spaced repetition, streaks and the data you own.
faq.a1: Yes. The full SM-2 algorithm, unlimited cards, AI lookup and streak tracking are free. There are no hidden paid tiers and no credit card is required.
faq.q2: How does the SM-2 algorithm work?
faq.a2: SM-2 spaces reviews according to how easily each word comes back. Words rated “Easy” wait longer; words rated “Hard” return sooner, just before you would forget them.
faq.q3: Can I import decks from Anki or Quizlet?
faq.a3: Yes. WordStreak accepts CSV, JSON and Anki decks (.apkg). The importer maps vocabulary, pronunciation, definitions and example sentences into your new deck.
faq.q4: What is the streak freeze for?
faq.a4: When life interrupts, the shield protects your streak through a missed day — the chain stays intact and the habit survives.
faq.q5: Can I study without a connection?
faq.a5: Yes. WordStreak stores data locally first, so you can review cards and take quizzes offline. Changes sync when you reconnect.

Memory is not

ch1.body: You forget most of what you learn within days — not from laziness, but because the mind clears space. WordStreak schedules a review just before a memory fades, then widens the interval.
